briefing: - 今日13个漏洞均无KEV/勒索标记，暂未见确凿在野利用。
- 批量公告13项，注入、认证绕过、反序列化为主，多个超9.8。
- 优先处置CVE-2026-129444：硬编码凭据CVSS10.0，立即改密隔离。
- 次优处置9.9分命令注入与堆溢出，优先补丁暴露服务。
- 仅Apache认证绕过见1个低热度PoC，利用成熟度低需监控。

items.title: Apache LDAP 默认认证绕过
items.title_zh: Apache LDAP 默认认证绕过
items.summary_zh: 知道有效用户名的攻击者可绕过 LDAP 绑定，以任意凭据登录该用户。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.affected: Apache(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级至 3.0.1 或更高版本，移除默认 AllowAll 匹配器
items.repro_note: 配置 LDAP Realm 后，提供已知用户名与任意密码验证是否跳过绑定
items.impact_scope: Java 认证框架，内网应用广泛
items.description: A cached authentication skips the LDAP bind, and the AllowAllCredentialsMatcher installed by default in DefaultLdapRealm accepts any credentials, allowing an attacker who knows a valid username to authenticate as that user. Mitigation: Upgrade to version 3.0.1 or later, which fixes the issue by no longer installing AllowAllCredentialsMatcher by default.

items.title: swmconfigupload 参数命令注入
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可操纵 swmconfigupload 参数注入系统命令，可能导致任意代码执行。
items.action_zh: 更新受影响组件，对 swmconfigupload 参数做白名单校验
items.repro_note: 向 swmconfigupload 参数注入命令分隔符，观察系统命令执行
items.impact_scope: 未知产品/组件，暴露面待确认
items.description: The manipulation of the argument swmconfigupload leads to command injection. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used.

items.title: Testimonial Slider RCE
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可提交恶意序列化数据触发对象注入，可能执行代码。
items.action_zh: 升级插件至修复版；无法升级则停用该插件
items.impact_scope: WordPress 插件，站点表单暴露
items.description: Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in Mamunur Rashid Testimonial Slider testimonial-slider-and-showcase allows Object Injection.This issue affects Testimonial Slider: from n/a through 3.0.2.

items.title: WP MCP Server 权限提升
items.title_zh: WP MCP Server 权限提升
items.summary_zh: 低权限用户可利用错误权限分配提升权限，进而控制 MCP 服务或站点管理功能。
items.action_zh: 升级 MCP Server 插件至修复版本，收紧角色权限
items.impact_scope: WP MCP 插件，后台提权
items.description: Incorrect Privilege Assignment vulnerability in AtlasAiDev MCP Server for WordPress ai-workflow-automation-ai-agent-hub allows Privilege Escalation.This issue affects MCP Server for WordPress: from n/a through 2.0.3.

items.title: VoAPI 日志查询 SQL 注入
items.title_zh: VoAPI 日志查询 SQL 注入
items.summary_zh: 已认证用户可在 /api/log 的 search 过滤键注入 SQL，读取 JWT 密钥并伪造管理员令牌。
items.action_zh: 升级修复版；过滤 search 键并轮换 JWT 签名密钥
items.repro_note: 认证后向 /api/log 的 search 键注入列名读取密钥
items.impact_scope: AI API 管理平台，令牌可横向
items.description: VoAPI 1.0.0 through 1.2.0 contains a sql injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to inject SQL by supplying crafted column names as search[...] filter keys on list endpoints such as GET /api/log. Attackers can read the HS256 JWT signing secret from the option table and forge a manager role token to take over the /api/m/* management API.

items.title: WP Data Access SQL注入
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可通过插件查询参数注入 SQL，读取或篡改数据库中的敏感数据。
items.action_zh: 升级插件至修复版本，限制低权限用户访问
items.impact_scope: WP 数据库插件，敏感数据风险
items.description: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in Passionate Programmer Peter WP Data Access wp-data-access allows SQL Injection.This issue affects WP Data Access: from n/a through 5.5.92.

items.title: WooCommerce 附加项路径遍历
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可构造路径参数读取受限目录外文件，可能泄露配置或敏感数据。
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.action_zh: 升级插件至修复版；无法升级则禁用该插件
items.description: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') vulnerability in Acowebs Woocommerce Custom Product Addons Pro woo-custom-product-addons-pro allows Path Traversal.This issue affects Woocommerce Custom Product Addons Pro: from n/a through 5.9.0.

items.title: AFI 表单集成权限提升
items.title_zh: AFI 表单集成权限提升
items.summary_zh: 低权限用户可利用权限分配错误提升权限，进而接管表单集成或站点管理功能。
items.action_zh: 升级插件至修复版本，审查表单集成权限分配
items.impact_scope: WP 表单插件，后台提权
items.description: Incorrect Privilege Assignment vulnerability in Nasir Ahmed Advanced Form Integration advanced-form-integration allows Privilege Escalation.This issue affects Advanced Form Integration: from n/a through 2.11.3.

items.title: jsondata 参数命令注入
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可操纵 jsondata 参数注入系统命令，可能导致任意代码执行。
items.action_zh: 更新受影响组件；对 jsondata 参数做严格校验
items.repro_note: 向 jsondata 参数注入命令分隔符，观察系统命令执行
items.impact_scope: 未知产品/组件，暴露面待确认
items.description: Such manipulation of the argument jsondata leads to command injection. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.

items.title: Cyrus SASL SRP 认证绕过
items.title_zh: Cyrus SASL SRP 认证绕过
items.summary_zh: 未认证网络客户端可发送 A=N 强制零共享密钥，冒充任意已存在用户并获取会话密钥。
items.action_zh: 升级至厂商修复版；无法升级则禁用或限制 SRP 认证机制
items.repro_note: 启用 SRP 服务端机制，发送 A=N 公钥值，观察零共享密钥通过认证
items.impact_scope: SASL 认证库，邮件/目录服务常用
items.description: Cyrus SASL through 2.1.28 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the SRP server mechanism because srp_server_mech_step2 does not reject client public values A that are multiples of N. Unauthenticated network clients can send A equal to N to force a zero shared secret, authenticating as any existing user without the password and learning session keys.

items.title: D-Link DSL-6740C 硬编码凭据
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可利用 FTP 守护进程硬编码凭据登录设备，获取文件访问或进一步控制。
items.action_zh: 升级固件或更换设备；限制 FTP 公网访问
items.repro_note: 访问设备 FTP 服务，尝试固件内置的硬编码账号密码
items.impact_scope: 老旧 D-Link 路由器，公网暴露风险
items.description: A vulnerability was identified in D-Link DSL-6740C 20131126. This affects an unknown function of the file /etc/templates/ftpd/ftpd_conf.php of the component FTP Daemon. Such manipulation leads to hard-coded credentials. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used.

items.title: DrayTek Vigor2960 堆溢出
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可能通过构造请求触发堆溢出，导致设备崩溃或潜在代码执行。
items.action_zh: 升级 Vigor2960 固件；限制管理面公网暴露
items.repro_note: 定位触发堆溢出的服务与请求字段，构造畸形报文测试
items.impact_scope: 边界路由器，公网暴露风险
items.description: A vulnerability was found in DrayTek Vigor2960 1.5.1.6. The exploit has been made public and could be used.

items.title: Estatik 插件文件包含
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可控制 include 文件名引入本地或远程文件，可能执行代码或泄露数据。
items.action_zh: 升级插件至修复版；无法升级则停用该插件
items.impact_scope: WP 插件，站点文件包含风险
items.description: Improper Control of Filename for Include/Require Statement in PHP Program ('PHP Remote File Inclusion') vulnerability in Estatik Estatik estatik allows PHP Local File Inclusion.This issue affects Estatik: from n/a through 4.3.6.
